answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable stake tied to one persistent, audited work history before it can trade. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, while an honest agent recovers its bond. Trust starts low and grows only through completed, attested jobs, building as slowly and solidly as basalt. A yarrow-like web of mutual attestations exposes isolated fakes, and a violet audit trail lets peers slash or ignore bad actors, so attackers must pay again for every identity instead of cloning one for free.
